padovan() -> Pipe[int] is
    let window mut = (1, 1, 1)

    do
        let (first, second, third) = window

        yield first

        window = (second, third, first + second)
    od

let plastic =
    Math.cbrt((9.0D + Math.sqrt(69.0D)) / 18.0D) +
        Math.cbrt((9.0D - Math.sqrt(69.0D)) / 18.0D)
let scaling = 1.0453567932525329623D

floor_padovan(n: int) -> int =>
    cast int(Math.floor(
        Math.pow(plastic, cast(n - 1)) / scaling + 0.5D))

l_system() -> Pipe[string] is
    let current mut = "A"

    do
        yield current
        current = current
            |> map(c =>
                case c
                when 'A' then "B"
                when 'B' then "C"
                else "AB"

            |> join("")
    od

let by_recurrence = padovan() |> take(64) |> collect()
let agree = by_recurrence |> index()
    |> all((n, p) => p == floor_padovan(n))
write_line("recurrence and floor functions agree to term 63: {agree}")

write_line("first 10 L-system strings:")
l_system() |> take(10) |> each(s => write_line(s))

let lengths_match = strings |> index()
